observations: Actual Requiem init calls item/entity/effect registration; PenanceStatusEffect registers three independent callbacks. Mortician native entity factory/goal registration invokes FreeFromMortailCoilGoal. Parent admits a live target if not already spellcasting and current age >= nextCastTime; start sets warmup20 and nextCastTime age+100, sets tracked casting flag and requests prepare sound. Tick reachingzero calls spell then cast sound and stopAnger independently of actual penalty success. Native GoalSelector priority/path/AI scheduling not executed.

Concrete Mortician cast samples current ServerPlayer target, chooses amplifier2 if actual possession host exists else1, requests Penance duration12000 then calls maxOutPenance even if addStatusEffect returned false. maxOut writes counter600 and attempts penalty immediately. Returned replacement soul is selected for knockback and velocity packet when nonnull, otherwise old player. No proof successful status acceptance, knockback, packet delivery or payment; no fabricated natural spawn/obtaining claim. Ichor supplies second concrete registered input: duration12000 amplifier0, server requests addStatusEffect and consumes/returns vessel independently of acceptance; it cannot by itself prove amplifier1/2 ordinary countdown entry.

Penance is one body-qualified coercive control policy, not three separately credited thresholds: cure callback checks BODY effect presence and vetoes at any level; PRE_MERGE checks POSSESSOR amplifier>=1; possession-start callback checks POSSESSOR amplifier>=2. Admission vetoes do not wait600. Cure aggregator FALSE dominates TRUE and actual canBeCured/start/finish cure chains recheck different necessary conditions; direct registered cure callback decrements only after predicate acceptance. PRE_MERGE aggregator stops on false before merge changes state. Mob possession actual start uses readiness first, then callback Result; DENY is false and prevents own startPossessing0.

PossessionStartCallback aggregator retains last nonPASS but DENY/HANDLED short-circuit. IdentifyingEvent uses HashMap values and bypasses aggregation when exactly one handler. Base blacklisting plus possessable/converted/soulless handlers are present; no stable order or universal override precedence across other installed callbacks proved. Client default ALLOW only when notsimulate; Penance callback has no explicit server exclusion and may deny client application too. Therefore never assert all eligible hosts always become possessed or all installed callbacks always see the Penance veto.

Counter starts-1. Server tick increments only if effect exists and current body fails effect-specific test: amplifier1 when !vagrant; amplifier2 and default branch first when !incorporeal, else falls through !vagrant. Mutable incorporeal means vagrant&&!possession; mortal Null state false/false. Pure soul can retain Penance with no pressure accumulation, amplifier1 permits a vagrant possessed-mob body while still vetoing shellmerge; amplifier2 pressures it. Otherwise nonnegative counter resets-1 and syncs. Fresh continuous pressure reaches600 on its601st admitted tick; after mortal reset0 reaches600 after600 further increments. These are source arithmetic, not measured scheduling.

At >=600 applyPenance first handles ServerPlayer amplifier>=1. Amplifier>=2 with ongoing possession invokes stopPossessing and returns Result(true,null). Otherwise nonvagrant demon requests splitPlayer(true) and returns Result(true, optionalSoul.orElse(null)); split true is declared even if Optional empty. Nonvagrant mortal requests MAGIC damage (amp+1)*4 ignoring boolean, resets counter0, returns Result(false,null). All other paths returnfalse/null. Existing-high counter on effect onApplied calls applyPenance directly, without the updatePenance FX wrapper. No per-hit immune reason or final HP receipt is produced.

updatePenance sends ETHEREAL_ANIMATION only for result.split, but sends separate component FX opcode for every >=600 attempt, including mortal damage and unsuccessful/no-op result; no accepted-outcome gate. DATA sync is skipped only when old owner.isRemoved, expressly to avoid writing old counter to new player object after split. FX and ethereal messages can still target the old connection. maxOut and onApplied can call penalty through separate paths; native reentry/order and repeated attempts not run, so no reproduced double damage or desync asserted.

Forced mob exit clears possession reference/conversionTimer, restores movement config based on current vagrant state, recalculates dimensions/air, sends sync/attributes and state callback before clearing host possessor. Host setter requires player state already cleared, retains prior possessor UUID, transfers fallDistance, clears sneak, toggles AI mechanism and removes speed modifiers. Server transfers mount; noncreative branch may transfer/drop inventory and clear player effects; soulbound host effects are then moved back and host sprint cleared. Registered PENANCE is soulbound. Item/AI/platform deeper helpers not atomic guarantees; removal/transfer/addEffect return outcomes not used as success receipt.

Demon split ignores PRE_SPLIT game conditions but still rejects removed/current-vagrant/state-disallowed player. PlayerSplitter creates shell, respawns old player with keepInventory temporarilyfalse restored in finally, rebinds connection, moves soulbound inventory, requests shell spawn ignoring boolean, sets anchor and invokes callbacks. Native prepare callback uses actual clone, Mutable prepares vagrant and copies currently positive StickyStatusEffect eligible for new demon. This generic remnant/shell copy machinery is already migration owner adc8de743cd7133ab85a and earns0 extra; no universal item safety or successful shell admission claim.

Penance declares shouldStick only for demon but shouldFreezeDuration false. Actual removal hook delegates player reapplicator; server copies positive-duration sticky effects into queue, next serverTick re-adds then removes each queued entry without checking success. Queue has no NBT persistence. Explicit effect-clear command clears queue after native removal. Existing positive demon status removal can be repaired on next tick; ordinary expired duration is not eligible. Core mirrored host/player add/update/remove hooks and host-last-tick retention are read; exact engine recursion/hidden-effect/tick ordering unexecuted, so no instantaneous permanent/universal immunity to all removals claimed.

Penance countdown raw integer is separately read/write NBT countdown, absent integer behavior follows native getInt; no own validation/clamp. Declared CCA player component strategy LOSSLESS_ONLY, owner-only sync by reference player==owner. This differs from remnant ALWAYS_COPY and possession INVENTORY; external CCA exact save/clone/transport implementation unexpanded. Ordinary load may retain numeric pressure; actual current effect/body evaluated next tick resets or resumes. No promise normal death preserves pressure or every split successfully transfers it.

Client DATA opcode0 writes counter; FX opcode1 calls pulse intensity5/color. clientTick uses constant0.4 while incorporeal and hasPenance, otherwise min(1,counter/600), lower bound unclamped; render lerps prior/current strengths and draws only f>0. Thus retained pure-soul restriction display need not indicate imminent penalty. Native registered GameRenderer mixin calls overlay; renderer submits additive tinted vanilla nausea texture, separate shader pulse100ticks nominal, endtick decrements and clears hue on expiry. Ether animation receiver schedules local sound/ten-tick animation with no outcome/target nonce; this is presentation request not actual heard/visible/native output acceptance.

Wizardry is spell timer/death/logout releasing a controlled actor; Nucleeper is renewable external precommit rollback before emission; Astral is captured ceremony owner with divergent protection membership and independent client/server completion. Proposed distinction is temporary tier/body-sensitive admission veto plus independently accumulated/reloaded pressure selecting forced host release, shell split, or repeated mortal hurt, with owner-only countdown and unconditional attempt FX.
